senses.gloss: ch.<cite ref="L00634">same</cite> <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 30:7">Gen. R. s. 30</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="L00634"><he>לפיד</he></cite>, <cite ref="Job 12:5">Job XII, 5</cite>) <he>תמן אמרין כרוז ליה ל׳ ליה</he> (Ar. <cite ref="L00626"><he>לפד</he></cite>) there (in certain places) they say (instead of) ‘he has a crier’ (that walks before him): ‘he has a torch’ (carried before him), i.e. he is a distinguished person.
